notes.title: Patch Beta 0.2
notes.content:
Additions

1. Added the last quests of the main storyline

2. Added a log showing rare items/money/xp/skills/esteem received in the lower left corner of the screen

3. Added an "Immunity" system, some enemies are immune to certain types of elements

4. Added a hidden item system that will be displayed if you have an item compass equipped

5. Added new weapons

6. Added new skills

7. Added a new weapon type "Staff"

8. Added a sprite of Laisa using a staff

9. Added breakable items in Dreadfort

10. Added breakable item "Void Metal"

11. Added a new tutorial "Hidden Item"

12. Added a crafting system for items in anvils scattered around the map

13. Added a special mechanic for an enemy

14. Added new attacks

15. Added new "Elements"

16. Added a new quest to search for a hidden item after talking with Alice before going to Duskwood

17. Added icons for trait attacks (Esteem/Mastery/Wisdom/Courage/Determination)

18. Added new end-game credits screen

19. Added Impact frames on enemies and breakable items

Changes

1. Changed Grimdur's location after the Memory Game quest

2. Changed some lighting

3. Changed combat tutorial to include "Immunity"

4. Temporarily changed Chests to "Shiny" items while we try to fix an issue with chests

Fixes

1. Fixed enemy not attacking

2. Fixed certain enemies not showing an image in the hud

3. Fixed certain enemies not doing damage

4. Fixed crystal shard sprites

5. Fixed some breakable item sprites

6. Fixed Esteem going into the negative

7. Fixed Esteem rising above max on certain items Occasions

8. Fixed Enemies not appearing when starting combat

9. Fixed bug where Laisa's head was "cut off" by the vendors in Largefield

10. Fixed current map not appearing correctly in save

11. Fixed sound options not working in main menu

12. Fixed Lava not appearing in Strongarm cave

13. Fixed enemies sometimes attacking after dying

14. Fixed "Always Run" not working properly

15. Fixed volume options in in-game options

16. Fixed certain sidequests being able to be abused to get infinite items

17. Fixed sidequests not deleting items correctly from inventory

notes.title: Patch 0.1.1.3
notes.content:
[olist]
 Fixed breakable items being impossible to break if you tried to interact with them before equipping the tool
 Fixed Alice's quest to get 3 silver ores where if you saved the game the ore disappeared
 Fixed issue with enemy encounters where you would encounter infinite enemies
[/olist]
